scientific.integrity: The first exactly dated public full scientific description of the model was online 18 January 2024; an earlier undated conference abstract appeared for the 1–4 December 2023 meeting without specifying the two-class equations, so its exact public upload day and applicability as the first source of this exact system are unverified. The published complete article and an author-hosted full preprint were inspected at the equations and examples; related immunity-stage published text was inspected. Exact polynomial and eigenvalue computations were reconstructed and replayed. No independent audit or external certification was performed.
scientific.limitations: Exact three-dimensional local spectral classification for n=2, total population 1, beta_s=beta_1=1, beta_2=0, mu_1=mu_2=0.01, 0<gamma<1. No nonlinear periodic-orbit existence, periodic-orbit stability, or global convergence is asserted.

title: Two sharp spectral crossings in a two-recovered-class epidemic model
